# Free Hugeicons used by Noma editor

Source: https://github.com/hugeicons/hugeicons/tree/main/icons

Original SVGs (Stroke Rounded, 24×24, MIT): `arrow-left-02.svg`, `more-horizontal.svg`, `search-01.svg`, `list.svg`, `keyboard.svg`. Android VectorDrawable translations in `app/src/main/res/drawable/noma_huge_*.xml`; stroke geometry retained. Copyright and permission notice in [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md).

These are the **free MIT icons** only. No Pro assets, downloads or redistributable Pro icon packs.
